sources.entry: SoundCleod - SoundCloud for macOS and Windows.

summary.one_liner: SoundCleod is a retired desktop app that wraps SoundCloud for macOS and Windows without a web browser; the maintainer has stopped maintaining it.
summary.what_it_does: SoundCleod is a desktop application that brings SoundCloud to macOS and Windows without using a web browser. Compared with using soundcloud.com in a browser, the README lists dark mode, desktop notifications, media key playback control, true full screen without browser buttons, and playback control from the macOS Notification Center Now Playing widget and the macOS application menu. It also stops playback when the computer sleeps and lets you close or hide all windows without interrupting audio. The README says the project is no longer maintained and recommends uninstalling it because no security fixes will be released.
use_cases: listen to SoundCloud on a Mac desktop app
play SoundCloud on Windows without a browser
control music playback with keyboard media keys
find alternatives to SoundCloud desktop clients
how_to_run: brew install soundcleod (Homebrew Cask, per README; the README notes this method is supported by the Caskroom team)
For macOS: download the .dmg installer from the README link, drag SoundCleod into Applications, and open it
For Windows: download the installer from the README link and run it
notable: Native desktop wrapper for SoundCloud that runs without a web browser
Uses macOS Now Playing widget and Notification Center for playback control
Supports keyboard media keys and macOS application menu controls
Listed alternatives include SoundCloud Desktop Player, BeardedSpice, Soundnode, Cumulus, Vox, and DaftCloud
caveats: No longer maintained; the README says not to use it and to uninstall it because security issues will not be fixed
Windows 7 or newer required, 64-bit only; 32-bit Windows is not supported
The soundcleod.com domain was set to expire on 2022-05-05
keywords: play soundcloud in its own window
